purpose: Spot-check the KIND_UNRESOLVED class found by the v21 full-database cross-check: ORIG/AP rows in the official Drugs@FDA Submissions file whose ApplNo is absent from the payload-derived window extract, so no NDA/ANDA/BLA type can be asserted. Three of the six NME-comparable-class candidates were probed on the Drugs@FDA website; one known-good application was fetched in the same session as a rendering control.

captures.subject: ApplNo 014262 - Drugs@FDA overview page
captures.finding: The page renders the Drugs@FDA shell only: no 'New Drug Application' header, no company line, no products table, no approval history. The application number does not resolve to a published application.
captures.verbatim_excerpt: 1. Home 2. Drug Databases 3. Drugs@FDA | Home | Previous Page | Back to Top
captures.project_effect: Confirms the invisibility class: the row exists in the official Submissions file but publishes nothing on the website and is absent from the openFDA payloads. Recorded as a review candidate in data/pre1980_full_db_crosscheck_1965_1976.csv, never added as an approval.

captures.subject: ApplNo 017383 - Drugs@FDA overview page
captures.finding: Empty application shell, identical pattern to DAF-U01: no header, no company, no products, no approval history.
captures.verbatim_excerpt: 1. Home 2. Drug Databases 3. Drugs@FDA | Home | Previous Page | Back to Top
captures.project_effect: A TYPE 1 / PRIORITY original approval dated 1973-02-20 exists in the official database and is invisible on both FDA query surfaces. This is the strongest single candidate for part of 1973's -3 gap; it is named, not added.

captures.subject: ApplNo 016486 - Drugs@FDA overview page
captures.verbatim_excerpt: 1. Home 2. Drug Databases 3. Drugs@FDA | Home | Previous Page | Back to Top
captures.project_effect: Named as a 1969 candidate; note 1969 is the one year where the project EXCEEDS the official count (+3), so this row does not close a gap - it is recorded for completeness.

captures.subject: CONTROL: NDA050495 (AMIKIN) - Drugs@FDA overview page, same session
captures.full_db_row: n/a - control application, present in the payloads and the window extract
captures.finding: Renders in full, proving the empty shells above are not a fetch artefact: header, company and a two-row products table are present, while no approval-history section is published.
captures.verbatim_excerpt: New Drug Application (NDA):050495 | Company:APOTHECON | Products on NDA 050495 | AMIKIN | AMIKACIN SULFATE | EQ 50MG BASE/ML **Federal Register determination that product was not discontinued or withdrawn for safety or effectiveness reasons** | INJECTABLE;INJECTION | Discontinued | None | Yes | No | AMIKIN | AMIKACIN SULFATE | EQ 250MG BASE/ML **Federal Register determination that product was not discontinued or withdrawn for safety or effectiveness reasons** | INJECTABLE;INJECTION | Discontinued | None | Yes | No | Showing 1 to 2 of 2 entries
captures.project_effect: Control for DAF-U01..U03: the fetch tool renders Drugs@FDA tables faithfully in this session, so an empty shell means the application publishes nothing.

limits: 3 of 7 candidates probed; the remaining 4 and the other 301 KIND_UNRESOLVED rows are unprobed. Application types (NDA vs ANDA vs BLA) are not assertable until fetch_jobs/drugsatfda_data_files_2026_09.json delivers Applications_all_types.txt.
